newsitem.title: USA: Gartner Group fluctuates after rating.
newsitem.headline: Gartner Group fluctuates after rating.

text.p: Shares of Gartner Group Inc fluctuated Thursday after Smith Barney initiated coverage of the stock as an outperform but set a second quarter earnings estimate that was below the Wall Street consensus, analysts said.

Analysts at other brokerage firms said investors were confused by the perceived mixed message sent by the Smith Barney report. Smith Barney analyst Brandt Sakakeeny did not return calls seeking comment.
Gartner's stock traded in a wide range Thursday, hitting a high of 26 and a low of 19-3/4 before settling at 20-7/8 in the late afternoon.

Smith Barney started coverage of Gartner, a technology market research firm, with an outperform rating. But the firm said it expects Gartner to earn $0.16 a share for the second quarter, below analysts' First Call consensus estimate of $0.18 a share. Additional details of the Smith Barney analysis were not available.
Despite Smith Barney's bearish second quarter estimate, other analysts were more optimistic.
"I'm extremely confidence Gartner will show sequential, accelerated growth in revenue and contracts. Their business is excellent," said Alex. Brown analyst Peter Appert.
Appert said he expects Gartner to earn $0.18 a share on revenues of $120 million for the March quarter.
Appert said the drop in Gartner's stock creates a buying opportunity. "The stock at $20 a share is a steal," Appert said.
